_comment: Machine-readable config for scripts/scrape.py. Human context in aims-collaboratory.md. The AIMS site itself blocks AI crawlers and is not scraped (decision 2026-06-15); its indexed entries live on third-party hosts. This config exists only for `--from-db` metadata passes over those hosts: no discovery, one page per row, date / authors / PDF taken from the pages' standard citation meta tags (process_staged page-meta fallback). host_allow keeps the pass to repositories and organisations whose pages we have read; commercial publishers (Springer, ACM, Sage, Emerald, MDPI, NBER) and code/platform hosts are left out.

date_from_url._comment: e4.northwestern.edu posts carry the date only in the WordPress permalink path; stamped date_source 'url' (2026-09-16).
